title.en: SAMPLE: An open dataset of 40,000 AI-run survey interviews
title.zh: SAMPLE：4 萬場由 AI 進行的調查訪談開放資料集

found.en: The Coldwater Institute survey lab released 40,000 interviews that an AI interviewer ran by chat with adult volunteers.
found.zh: Coldwater Institute 的調查實驗室公開了 4 萬場訪談，由 AI 訪談員透過聊天，與成年志願者進行。

matters.en: Surveys take a great deal of time. A shared dataset lets other researchers study how AI interviewers work.
matters.zh: 問卷調查非常耗時。共用的資料集，讓其他研究者能研究 AI 訪談員是怎麼運作的。

ai_helped.en: The Coldwater Institute survey lab built Survey Voice, which asked the questions and followed up on answers. People wrote the questions and checked a sample of the transcripts.
ai_helped.zh: Coldwater Institute 的調查實驗室開發了 Survey Voice，由它提問，並針對回答追問。問題由人類撰寫，並由人類抽查部分逐字稿。

how_sure.en: Preprint. SSRN hosts the paper, which has not been peer reviewed. The Coldwater Institute survey lab, which built the system, is the source.
how_sure.zh: 預印本。論文放在 SSRN 上，尚未經過同儕審查。這項消息的來源是開發這套系統的 Coldwater Institute 調查實驗室。

background.en: Researchers use interviews to learn what people think and why.
background.zh: 研究者用訪談來了解人們怎麼想，以及為什麼這麼想。

could_lead.en: AI interviewers could make large surveys cheaper, if their answers match those of people.
could_lead.zh: 如果 AI 訪談員得到的答案和真人一致，大型問卷調查可能因此變得更便宜。

evidence.quote: Survey Voice asked the questions and followed up on answers
